title: Nvidia after Huang: the stake, the supply chain, the board

scenes.narration: [excited] Jensen Huang just left Nvidia. His stake of 3.5 percent was almost worth $200 one month ago.
scenes.imagePrompt: a single small wedge of warm gold light cut from a huge dark glowing disc, floating above a black glass floor in a vast hall
scenes.motionPrompt: slow push-in, the gold wedge glows brighter

scenes.narration: Here is what the filings say about the board, the ownership, and the supply chain.
scenes.imagePrompt: three ornate gold keys fanned out on a black marble desk under a warm spotlight
scenes.motionPrompt: slow push-in, light sweeps across the keys

scenes.narration: On November Twelve, Nvidia's board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation as chief executive and director, effective immediately.
scenes.imagePrompt: a crisp white document sealed with a gold wax stamp on a black desk, soft warm spotlight, calm and precise
scenes.motionPrompt: slow push-in on the gold seal

scenes.narration: The SEC filing gives no reason for Jensen's departure.
scenes.imagePrompt: a brass magnifying glass resting on a white page, warm gold light across the paper, quiet and careful

scenes.narration: CFO Colette Kress, fifty-nine, becomes interim CEO, and keeps her finance role while the search runs.
scenes.imagePrompt: a gold relay baton leaving one hand and reaching another across a dark glass track, streaks of warm light
scenes.motionPrompt: baton glides forward, light trails stream behind it

scenes.narration: Kress has been CFO since twenty thirteen, after finance roles at Cisco, Microsoft and Texas Instruments.
scenes.imagePrompt: a winding ribbon of gold light threading through three glass skyscrapers at dusk

scenes.narration: Harvey Jones, a director since nineteen ninety-three, becomes the board's first-ever chair.
scenes.imagePrompt: a brand-new leather chair at the head of a long boardroom table, glowing in warm gold light, welcoming, skyline behind

scenes.narration: The board will weigh internal and external candidates, and earnings stay on schedule for November seventeenth.
scenes.imagePrompt: a gold telescope on a rooftop terrace pointing across a glowing city skyline at dusk, wide horizon

scenes.narration: The proxy puts his stake at eight hundred seventy million shares, as of March twenty-third.
scenes.imagePrompt: a gold ribbon bookmark lying across a thick closed ledger on a black desk, warm lamp light

scenes.narration: Fifty-nine million of those shares sit in a family foundation he has no financial interest in.
scenes.imagePrompt: a single small glowing gold coin set apart from a larger pile of coins on a black marble table, gentle light
scenes.motionPrompt: slow push-in on the lone coin

scenes.narration: Leave those out, and his latest filing adds up to about three point three percent.
scenes.imagePrompt: a precision brass scale balancing a stack of gold coins against a glowing white weight, soft light

scenes.narration: At Wednesday's closing price, that stake was worth about [emphasis] one hundred forty-one billion dollars.
scenes.imagePrompt: a towering column of stacked gold coins rising into warm light inside a dark vault, dramatic scale
scenes.motionPrompt: camera tilts up the column of coins

scenes.narration: Nvidia has one class of stock, so Huang had no special voting power.
scenes.imagePrompt: a row of identical gold ballot boxes lined up evenly on a black marble table, perfectly equal

scenes.narration: Vanguard alone holds seven point three percent, more than twice his stake.
scenes.imagePrompt: one tall gold pillar standing beside a pillar half its height in a dark gallery, warm rim light

scenes.narration: The business he leaves is still growing. Last quarter's revenue was [emphasis] ninety-six point two billion dollars.
scenes.imagePrompt: a river of golden light streaming upward through a canyon of black glass data center towers
scenes.motionPrompt: light surges upward through the canyon

scenes.narration: Guidance for this quarter is one hundred eight billion dollars, plus or minus two percent.
scenes.imagePrompt: a horizon of warm gold light brightening beyond rows of black server racks
scenes.motionPrompt: slow push-in as the horizon brightens

plate.label: Q3 revenue outlook, plus or minus 2%

scenes.narration: Two customers alone made up thirty-six percent of last fiscal year's sales.
scenes.imagePrompt: two huge gold doors in a black wall, far larger than the many small doors around them, warm light
scenes.motionPrompt: slow push-in toward the two large doors

scenes.narration: Nvidia designs chips but does not make them. TSMC and Samsung make the wafers.
scenes.imagePrompt: a glowing gold architect's blueprint hovering above a pristine empty factory floor, black and gold
scenes.motionPrompt: slow push-in as blueprint lines glow

scenes.narration: Memory comes from SK Hynix, Micron and Samsung, in a supply chain concentrated mainly in Asia.
scenes.imagePrompt: rows of glowing gold memory modules stacked like a city skyline against a black sky
scenes.motionPrompt: slow pan across the skyline of modules

scenes.narration: To lock in that supply, Nvidia has paid premiums, made deposits, and signed long-term capacity agreements.
scenes.imagePrompt: a gold shipping container sealed with a heavy brass lock on a black glass dock at dusk

scenes.narration: Its supply and purchase obligations total [emphasis] ninety-five point two billion dollars.
scenes.imagePrompt: an endless warehouse corridor of gold-lit containers stretching to the horizon, sense of scale

scenes.narration: TSMC told investors in October that demand is still far above what it can supply.
scenes.imagePrompt: a pristine silicon wafer glowing gold under bright light in a spotless fabrication hall, precise robotic arm

scenes.narration: So who negotiates those supply allocations day to day? The public record does not say.
scenes.imagePrompt: a long polished table with three glass chairs and soft gold light, quiet and thoughtful

scenes.narration: What it does show is Huang as the public face of Nvidia's biggest government deals.
scenes.imagePrompt: a single gold spotlight on an empty keynote stage in a huge dark arena, warm and anticipatory

scenes.narration: In Saudi Arabia, a first phase of eighteen thousand chips, and several hundred thousand over five years.
scenes.imagePrompt: a futuristic desert data center campus glowing gold at sunset, endless dunes, sleek black buildings
scenes.motionPrompt: slow aerial glide over the campus

scenes.narration: In Washington, one analyst called him Nvidia's lead voice on China.
scenes.imagePrompt: a white marble capitol dome at dusk with warm gold light on its columns, serene

scenes.narration: Yet China is now effectively closed to its data center chips, according to Nvidia's own annual report.
scenes.imagePrompt: a tall gold gate in a black wall, half open, warm light streaming through the gap

scenes.narration: Nvidia's own risk factor points to its executive team, not to one person.
scenes.imagePrompt: a circle of glowing gold silhouette figures standing shoulder to shoulder, warm light, abstract and faceless

scenes.narration: As of Thursday, we found no supplier statement on the change. That is the gap to watch.
scenes.imagePrompt: a quiet control room with one glowing gold dial pointing at an open gap on a curved gauge

scenes.narration: Watch November seventeenth: the first earnings call with Kress as interim chief executive.
scenes.imagePrompt: a gold hourglass with a stream of glowing light flowing through it against a black background

scenes.narration: Then the CEO search, any supplier or customer comments, and Congress's request for a briefing.
scenes.imagePrompt: a gold compass on black marble pointing forward, soft rays of warm light

scenes.narration: That is the picture from the filings. Full breakdown at the link in bio.
scenes.imagePrompt: the Manhattan skyline at dusk with warm gold light reflected on the river, serene and wide
